reason: Our buyers have never asked for this before the home is built, and we already get plans, elevations and renderings through our architect and in-house people. I'm not adding $1,500 a home across a big plan library for something nobody is requesting.
objection: Spec buyers don't ask for a walkthrough of an unbuilt home, and we already have renderings covered inside the architecture fee, so this is a cost with no sale attached to it.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another Utah spec builder that it measurably sped up pre-sales or cut change orders, at a per-plan price that works across a 50-plan library.
